Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk

The latest Market Talks covering the Auto and Transport sector. Published exclusively on Dow Jones Newswires at 4:20 ET, 12:20 ET and 16:50 ET.

1220 ET – A tanker carrying Russian diesel briefly signaled it was headed to the U.S., according to ship-tracking data from Kpler. The Sierra Leone-flagged Tewest vessel loaded around 40,000 metric tons of ultra-low-sulfur diesel from Primorsk, Russia, on Sunday. After first signaling “New York” with an estimated arrival of Dec 3., it switched to “for orders,” a designation typically indicating a vessel has no confirmed final discharge port. The same happened in late October to the Malta-flagged tanker Agioi Fanendes, which is now stalled in the North Atlantic off the U.S. East Coast, according to Kpler. No cargoes of Russian diesel have reached the U.S. since President Trump announced a deal to import the Kremlin’s fuel. (giulia.petroni@wsj.com)
